criteria.detail: Both blank and order catalogs filter their names, codes, descriptions and regulatory text using the shared matcher.
Shared matcher tests pass for normalization, all-word matching, typo/layout support and empty-query restoration.
Interaction fixture passes filtering, group hiding, live counts, zero results, reset focus and Escape at 375px; responsive width classes reviewed.
AST comparisons preserve all download/link attributes, metadata and FAQ; server content, sorting and existing localized journal search retained.
Fresh lint, 26 focused tests, interaction/integration checks, targeted gate and full typecheck all exit 0; current source hashes match verification inputs.
Admin helper translator uses its caller namespace; emitted JavaScript is byte-identical to HEAD; typecheck and requisite tests pass.

limitations: Browser interactions use a component fixture, not a deployed full-page end-to-end session.
Production deployment has not been verified by this evidence.
